_comment: Curated Custom Battle commander lists per faction. Key = culture StringId (vlandia = Rohan). Values = lord StringIds in display order. A configured faction shows EXACTLY this list (bypassing the default top-3 alphabetical + the 2-segment-id regex + the culture filter), so 3-segment ids and cross-culture lords are allowed. Factions NOT listed keep the default behavior. Reuse.Singleton: edits require a full game restart.
